written_before: the Stage A test stage runs
test_cases: 96 held-out paired cases: 8 directions x 3 calibrated levels x 4 seeds, half with a second hit
score: J = tilt integral [2 s, t0) + tilt integral [t0, t0+1.5 s] (deg s) + 0.2 x max|z-z(t0)| (cm); crash = 60 + 40 x unflown window fraction
best_single: the single-mode controller (pulse, gs, oneshot, deadzone) with the lowest mean test J
GO: C1: auto beats best_single: (survivals_auto - survivals_single >= 8 and McNemar exact p < 0.05) or (mean J_auto <= 0.85 x mean J_single and auto wins >= 60% of paired cases with sign-test p < 0.05)
C2: auto also has lower mean thrust-unit peak tilt and lower mean recovery time (censored at 1.5 s) than best_single
C3: the better of oneshot and gs captures < 80% of the auto gain over pid: (J_pid - J_best_os_gs) / (J_pid - J_auto) < 0.8, with J_auto < J_pid
if_fail: Stage A NO-GO: report the classical result only; Stage B (SNN/NEAT) needs the user's approval anyway
